meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

copy.tagline: 通过高强度提问打磨你的方案或设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在落地前发现计划中的漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen your plan or design through relentless questioning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to uncover flaws in your plan before execution

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会发起一场持续的追问式访谈,针对你的计划或设计反复提问、挑毛病,帮你把想法打磨得更扎实。
howto.when: 当你在对话中启动 /grilling 会话,或明确要求使用 grill-me 时触发。技能默认不会由模型自动调用。

say.text: 用 grill-me 拷问一下我的产品方案。
say.note: Claude 会开始一轮尖锐提问。

say.text: 启动 /grilling,测试我的发布计划。
say.note: 它会逐条追问计划中的漏洞。

say.text: 对我的设计做一次压力面试。
say.note: Claude 以访谈形式帮你完善设计。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude runs a relentless interview session that questions your plan or design repeatedly to sharpen it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start a /grilling session or explicitly ask to use grill-me; it is not invoked automatically by the model.

say_en.text: Use grill-me to grill my product proposal.
say_en.note: Claude starts a sharp round of questions.
It probes weaknesses one by one.

say_en.text: Run a pressure interview on my design.
say_en.note: Claude helps refine the design through Q&A.
